records.before_english: I planned to improve my way[a], and I will not turn back, for I will find it.
records.after_english: I planned to improve my way[a], and I will not turn back, for I will find it[b].

records.before_english: My soul clung to her, and I did not turn my face away from her.
records.after_english: My soul clung to her, and I will not turn my face away from her[a][b]. My hand opened her gates[c], and I will make my way to her and gaze upon her[d].

records.before_english: I gave my soul after her, and for everlasting ages I will not turn away from her. In purity I found her, and from the beginning I acquired a heart for her.
records.after_english: I devoted my soul to pursuing her[a], and for everlasting ages I will not turn away from her. In purity I found her, and from the beginning[b] I acquired a heart for her[c].

records.before_english: My inward parts burned like an oven as I looked toward her[a]; therefore I will not forsake her.
records.after_english: My inward parts burned like an oven as I looked toward her[a]; therefore I will not forsake her[b].

records.before_english: Yahweh has given me the reward of my lips[b][a]; therefore I acquired her as a good possession.
records.after_english: Yahweh has given me the reward of my lips[a]; therefore I acquired her[b] as a good possession[c].

records.before_english: Turn to me[a], you who are simple[b], and lodge in the house of my instruction.
records.after_english: Turn to me, you who are simple[a], and lodge in the house of my instruction[b].

records.before_english: How long will you lack these things[a], while your soul is very thirsty?
records.after_english: How long will you lack these things[a], while your soul is very thirsty[b]?

records.before_english: I opened my mouth and spoke of her: acquire wisdom for yourselves without silver[a].
records.after_english: I opened my mouth and spoke of her[a]: acquire wisdom for yourselves without silver[b].

records.before_english: Bring your neck under her yoke[a], and let your soul bear her burden. She is near to those who seek her, and the one who gives himself finds her.
records.after_english: Bring your neck under her yoke[a], and let your soul bear her burden[b]. She is near to those who seek her, and the one who gives himself finds her[c].

records.before_english: See with your own eyes that I was young[b][a], and I stood by her and found her.
records.after_english: See with your own eyes that I was young[a], and I stood by her[b] and found her[c].

records.before_english: Many heard my instruction in my youth[b][a], and they acquired silver and gold by me.
records.after_english: Many heard my instruction in my youth[a], and you will acquire silver and gold[b] through me[c].

records.before_english: May my soul rejoice in my old age[a], and may you not be put to shame by my song.
records.after_english: May my soul rejoice in my old age[a], and may you not be put to shame by my song[b].

records.before_english: Do your work in righteousness[a], and he will give you your reward in its time. Blessed is Yahweh forever, and praised is his name from generation to generation.
records.after_english: Do your work in righteousness[a], and he will give you your reward in its time[b]. Blessed is Yahweh forever, and praised is his name from generation to generation[c].
